bank.title: Sample Source Question Bank
bank.description: A two-question package used to demonstrate the import format.

questions.question: Which property is required for a valid imported question?
choices: At least two choices and a correct answer matching one choice letter
A shared question id with K&S
questions.explanation: The package validator requires at least two choices and a correct letter found in the choice-letter array.

questions.question: How is progress kept separate between question banks?
choices: By bank id and question id together
questions.explanation: Progress uses a compound bank-and-question identifier.
